findings.summary: Biased pair-acquisition selects poll unauthenticated bridge work before an already-ready authenticated shutdown, so a sustained invalid-candidate stream can starve lifecycle control indefinitely.
A deferred grant at the FIFO head waits unconditionally in Idle, so grant then shutdown can remain blocked forever even after the replacement bridge acknowledges RomReady.
Reconnect state forgets that an authenticated bridge ended ambiguously; replacement-control EOF can therefore be misclassified as emulator-exit proof after bridge RST.
AwaitDecision's absolute deadline is not advanced during pair acquisition, permitting indefinite pending state and a permanently ledgered WrongState shutdown after expiry.
The ACK-loss replay test does not deterministically prove the first ACK write failed.
